pages.title: Scope
pages.body:
## In scope
- invoices and credit notes
- one date range per export

## Out of scope
- exports of payments; the bank statement covers them

pages.title: Data flow
pages.body:
The export reads the invoices once and streams them out:

![Export data flow](/epics/00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000006/dossier-assets/00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000008/content)

1. the list sends its filter
2. the service streams the rows
3. the browser saves the file

pages.title: Rollout
pages.body: Ship the CSV export first. The PDF export follows once the accountants confirm the columns.
